predictions: Russian sentences containing a Latin-script word reach 0.3-1.1 on that word's first token. The same sentences written entirely in Russian stay under 0.25, and the same Latin words inside English sentences stay under 0.1.
notes: Probe: 'где u можно' 1.098 (peak ' u'), Bluem|ountain Cookie 0.499, P.S. 0.488, 'папку C:\Tools' 0.468, 'ресторане Mexican кухни' 0.328; pure Russian twins 0.085 and 0.214 (the latter peaks on '.' after мексиканском), English 'folder C:\Tools' 0.048, Korean 'FAQ 페이지' 0.140, floor 0.004. Card: 'P', ' u', 'H', ' F', 'o' (a Latin o inside авиапассажирoв), ' I', ' Mexican', 'A', 'ountain', ' C' all inside Russian or Korean text (max 70, layer 25); the + pole peaks on Cyrillic capitals ' Г', ' Д', ' О'. Script switch is the distinction.
